_about: Rewards maths defaults (PRISM v0.4 §8.4). The Reward_Policy sheet of an uploaded workbook overrides these. All money figures are fictional placeholders, to be sourced before final.
_min_rating_for_bonus: No annual bonus below this rating (1-5). Commission, gainsharing, merit and the learning wallet follow their own rules.

sales._kicker: Top-20% kicker (spec §8.4): paid to the top 20% of the ranked sales pool who passed the fair-selling gate, as a % of their commission.

gainsharing._about: Savings = (average output % above standard) × line payroll × value_of_extra_output_share_of_payroll (placeholder: each 1% of extra output is worth 0.5% of the line's payroll). The pool is pool_share_of_savings_pct of the savings (Strategy DNA team orientation can raise it, see dna.json), split by attendance-adjusted hours.

learning_wallet._about: Spec §8.4: fixed per head (Reward_Policy learning_wallet) + top-up by potential and capability gap. Counted in total rewards.
